# grouping

Benchmarks of [`ordito.grouping`](../api/ordito/grouping.md) against every library that computes the same thing. Each chart shows the time of every library relative to ordito on CUDA (1x, in green): a longer bar took longer. The table under each chart lists every input the function was measured on. See [Benchmarks](index.md) for how to read and reproduce these numbers.

*Measured on GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 · CPU: Intel Xeon w7-2495X*

## Without a reference

No other library computes these, so they have no comparison. ordito (CUDA)'s median time on the largest input it was measured on:

| Function | Input | ordito (CUDA) |
|---|---|---|
| `unique_1d` | lucy | 11.32 ms |
| `hashed_occurrence_counts` | lucy | 36.74 ms |
| `first_occurrence_indices` | lucy | 801.6 µs |
| `hash_rows` | lucy | 928.4 µs |
| `hash_vector_rows` | lucy epsilon=0.0001 | 483.8 µs |
| `hash_indices_rows` | lucy | 924.2 µs |
| `sorted_undirected_edge_keys` | lucy | 11.20 ms |
